title: Everyone can Duolingo
slide_intent: Connect a short promise to a welcoming character because people need to recognize who a service is for before considering its features.
strategic_value: The inclusive phrase and familiar illustration style can make Duolingo’s language-learning mission feel approachable.
demonstration: A bespectacled character stands beside three lines reading “everyone can duolingo”; the brand name is green and the preceding words are gray.
practical_value: Use a simple promise and character together when introducing the audience’s place in a brand story.

content_islands.name: Character
content_islands.spec: Place the tall illustrated figure at left, with blue hat and scarf above a gray coat.

content_islands.name: Promise
content_islands.spec: Stack the message at right and distinguish the brand name through green.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Johnson Banks account says the narrative expresses universal access through the idea that everyone can Duolingo.
reference_purposes.Expression: Rounded lettering and a flat illustrated character give the inclusive phrase a distinct visual voice.
